cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Consensus Means Me
cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You nodded at Friday. I'll tell the committee you've accepted me as project lead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only agreed to the meeting date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Exactly. Everyone's following the timetable I set.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll attend, but I'm voting against your budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll introduce you as my finance watchdog. It's good to have the whole committee behind my leadership.
